751-4289-4785.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2111-3545-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

2403-4496-5220-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

5412-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability.
Repeat from step 4.

2438-4907-6747-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
2438-4907-6747-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static effect.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

2191-2942-4416.notablePrerequisites: You are able to deal damage to a creature.
2191-2942-4416.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Phyrexian Vindicator.
Activate Phyrexian Vindicator by paying {0}, targeting a creature.
Attempt to deal damage to the targeted creature. The damage will then be increased due to Fiery Emancipation, then redirected to Phyrexian Vindicator, which is then redirected back to the creature that was originally targeted.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Vindicator by paying {0}, targeting the creature. 
Repeat step 4 until all damage will be redirected to Phyrexian Vindicator.
Repeat from step 3.

2557-4508-5880-7040.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

413-586-5258-5618-6967.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, adding {B}{B}{B} and untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6259-6604.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3234-3293-5147-5414.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5147-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5147-5414.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1365-1651-2511-6701.easyPrerequisites: You control two nontoken artifact creatures, one of which does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1651-2511-6701.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving two nontoken artifact creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken artifact creatures, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing one of the nontoken artifact creatures that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other artifact creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3 once, instead sacrificing the creature who had counters placed on it in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.

864-3542-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
864-3542-6485.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Eternal Witness and Palinchron, targeting Eternal Witness
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Palinchron.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Eternal Witness and Palinchron tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

478-804-2821-3007-3573.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2821-3007-3573.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
478-804-2821-3007-3573.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
478-804-2821-3007-3573.description:
Animate Candelabra using Toymaker
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Tolarian Academy.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

2103-2304-3019-3617-5546.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
Capture of Jingzhou and Time Walk exiled by Arcane Bombardment.
2103-2304-3019-3617-5546.description:
Cast Inspiring Refrain by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Arcane Bombardment triggers, exiling a random instant or sorcery from your graveyard, and then casting a copy of Capture of Jingzhou and Time Walk without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the Capture of Jingzhou and Time Walk copies, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain, causing you to draw two cards and exile Inspiring Refrain with three time counters on it.
Activate Jhoira's Timebug by tapping it, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain.
Move to your first extra turn, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain during your upkeep.
Move to your second extra turn, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain during your upkeep.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

1874-3000-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1874-3000-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

85-1032-2178.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
85-1032-2178.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1902-3464-3657.notablePrerequisites: There are at least five Elves on the battlefield.
1902-3464-3657.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1902-3464-3657.notes: If you get infinite mana, you can repeat steps 2-5 infinitely to untap any other creature(s)

4449-4893-4949.notablePrerequisites: Hateflayer does not have summoning sickness.
4449-4893-4949.description:
Activate Hateflayer by tapping it, adding {R} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Hateflayer by paying {R} and untapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

2-1170-2364-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Ancestral Statue.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Ancestral Statue.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

38-4763-4766.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Koll and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning Skirk Prospector from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

618-2197-2816-5313.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Kiki-Jiki.
Your devotion to green is at least seven.
618-2197-2816-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Nylea's Disciple with haste.
The token enters gaining you at least 9 life.
Pay 9 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}.
Pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
